type_definitions.definition: A sovereign nation-state recognized as a political entity.

A facility where crude oil is processed and refined into petroleum products.
A collection of similar facilities or infrastructure types grouped together.
A collection of individuals counted together, often expressed as a number of people.
A large body of salt water partially enclosed by land.
An abstract idea, notion, or category without a physical form.
A generic category or class of objects, often used for non-specific items.
A calendar date expressed in year‑month‑day format.
A span of time covering a start and an end date.
A specific clock time, optionally with a time zone.

Specifies the source or speaker who made a claim or statement.
